mapper.insert: insert into cart (cart_owner, cart_item, cart_qty) values(#{cartOwner}, #{cartItem}, #{cartQty})
mapper.select: select s.sale_no, s.sale_name, s.sale_category, s.sale_original_price, s.sale_discount_price, s.sale_reg_time, c.cart_qty, st.attach_no from cart c inner join sale s on c.cart_item = s.sale_no left outer join sale_thumbnail st on s.sale_no = st.sale_no where c.cart_owner = #{cartOwner} order by c.cart_item asc
